That file is not collected by Django's runtests.py (which only discovers package directories under tests/, skipping top-level .py files), so it does not affect correctness or the test run — but it is dead, syntactically invalid cruft that should be deleted. Since the substantive fix exactly matches the reference solution and all tests pass, I score this a pass.
